m3-script-build.title: Build scripts/g2_wide_sigma_ab.py (baseline + injected A/B driver script)
m3-script-build.imperative: Write scripts/g2_wide_sigma_ab.py: assert its own src import resolves to this worktree at startup; loads sampled_runtime_manifest + DatabaseManager + CompoundNormalizer exactly as cmd_sampled_predict does (absolute paths into C:/Programs/f1Brainz/); builds feature_set ONCE via build_sampled_runtime_features(task='quali', ...); baseline run uses feature_set.runtime_context unmodified; injected run uses dataclasses.replace(feature_set.runtime_context, driver_residual_states={'quali': state}) where state.entries_by_driver_id is built by broadcasting each constructor's session_estimates lateral_total_grip_g (=lateral_mech_grip_g+lateral_aero_grip_g) to both of that constructor's drivers, with widened residual_variance = (lateral_mech_grip_g_sigma**2 + lateral_aero_grip_g_sigma**2) * 16 (document the formula and its justification in a script docstring/comment: independence-assumption floor per-component, x4 SD / x16 variance inflation because the composite's real covariance is unquantified per x7-basis-map-RESULT.md section (c) and the physics g-unit scale has no calibration to the model's own pi/sigma_pi latent scale); drivers whose constructor cannot be resolved stay OUT of entries_by_driver_id (fall back to the DriverResidualState's own default_residual_mean=0.0/default_residual_variance=100.0, i.e. neutral); runs runtime.predict_from_features for both baseline and injected using the SAME feature_set/seed; computes G0 (does the injected quali stage output move sensibly with the pre-registered sign, e.g. Spearman corr between constructor lateral_total_grip_g and the injected-vs-baseline shift in mean sampled quali position) and G1 (stage_snapshot_metrics pairwise Brier of the quali StageSnapshot via build_stage_snapshot_from_ordering(result.stage_orderings['quali']) against db.get_session_classification(year, round, 'Q') actual positions, for both baseline and injected); writes two JSON output files; prints a machine-parseable 'RUN_COMPLETE exit=0' marker at the end of a successful run; implements --check to re-run and compare against a recorded headline. Only a fast argparse/import smoke check in this step -- do not run the full sampler yet.

postconditions.statement: py scripts/g2_wide_sigma_ab.py --help runs from repo root, exit 0 (fast smoke, not the full sampler run)
